bifrost: springboard/src/bare/kms.rs, springboard/src/bare/input.rs, springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs, springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs, springboard/src/media/volume.rs, springboard/src/bare/power.rs, springboard/src/shell/battery.rs, springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs
summary: IOKit's device-access layer exists on BifrOSt only in the Linux system layer (sysfs, /dev nodes, DRM, evdev, v4l2, ALSA control, Bluetooth), used by the shell and daemons. Apps get no device-registry, matching, notification or driver-call API, so the framework is not offered to SDK apps; the serial-port modem sample has no counterpart.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-iokit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Enumeration happens inside the shell and daemons with sysfs and /dev scans; no SDK call returns a list of devices by class.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-iokit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Properties come from sysfs text files. No general registry walk and no typed property API for apps.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-iokit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Changes are found by polling. The shell reacts; no app receives a device-arrival event.

Blocked: a generic driver-call API needs a shell broker that checks an app's grant before it issues an ioctl on a device node, and no such broker or grant record exists. The shell keeps its ioctl calls private (v4l2.rs, kms.rs), so apps get no method call and no mapped memory.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs (mmap'd capture buffers); springboard/src/bare/scanout.rs (buffer allocation for display)
features.note: Blocked: the shell's mmap'd capture and scanout buffers are private to the shell, and no shared-memory channel from a driver to an app is defined in springboard/proto, so a data-queue type would have no producer to read from.

features.apple: IOPowerSources (power source APIs built on IOKit)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 4 (w4-iokit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Battery state reaches the shell and the menu bar. No SDK API returns it to apps.

features.apple: IOKit thermal notifications, surfaced through ProcessInfo.thermalState
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests. Reads the thermal zones once per call and reports a state. No change notification and no per-zone detail.

features.apple: IOAccelerator and IOGraphics services, reached through IOKit
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/display_info.rs (DisplayInfo, main_display, active, diff); springboard/sdk/src/displays.rs (display service client); springboard/src/bare/kms.rs (Display, open_first_available)
features.note: The display list, main display, active filter, point lookup and reconfiguration diffs are tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: graphics accelerators are not exposed, the shell alone drives DRM/KMS, and the display service client is not verified on the lab machine.

features.apple: IOHIDManager and HID element APIs (IOKit HID classes)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/hid_devices.rs (DeviceManager, matching, changes); springboard/ui/src/hid_match.rs (Criteria, Usage, Role); springboard/src/bare/input.rs:498 (evdev devices by capability, hot-rescanned, the snapshot source)
features.note: Apps get the matching criteria and the matched and removed devices between snapshots, tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: the shell supplies the snapshots, and apps get no raw input reports.

features.apple: IOAudio and audio device services used by Core Audio
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/default_device.rs (Defaults, Device, Role); springboard/sdk/src/audio_devices.rs (audio-devices service client); springboard/src/media/volume.rs:23 (CONTROL_DEVICE /dev/snd/controlC0)
features.note: The default device for input, output and sound effects, with a chosen default that returns after the device comes back, is tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: the audio-devices client is not verified on the lab machine, and playback and capture still go through the audiod daemon.

features.apple: IOKit camera and video device services (used by AVFoundation)
features.note: Capture node usability, format choice and the buffer plan are tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: only the shell opens the camera through V4L2, so no app receives a capture device list or frames.

The remote device list, one entry per address with paired and connected state in Settings order, is tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: no app receives the shell's scan results, and pairing and discovery are not reachable from apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/net_interfaces.rs (parse_operstate, parse_hardware_address, classify, from_entries, list); springboard/src/net/wifi.rs:630 (adapter link and address from sysfs)
features.note: The SDK lists each adapter's name, kind, link state and hardware address, and its parsers and classification are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-rest-03.rs. Gap: list() reads /sys/class/net on the lab machine only, no app receives change events, and the shell's wifi.rs link reader does not yet use the SDK model.

features.apple: IOSerialPort sample, Communicating with a Modem on a Serial Port
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-14, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No serial-port enumeration or modem open path exists for apps. The sample has no counterpart.

features.apple: IOKit driver model; DriverKit is required for devices on macOS 11 and later (per the IOKit landing page)
features.bifrost: Linux kernel drivers are used as-is (sysfs names such as i915 and amdgpu in springboard/src/bare/kms.rs:463)
features.note: Apple's driver model does not apply to BifrOSt; drivers run in the Linux kernel.

features.feature: IOKit data types, constants and enumerations
features.apple: IOReturn, IOOptionBits, IOMessage, IOByteCount and related C typedefs
features.note: C-level type definitions for the Mach-IOKit ABI. They have no Rust-side counterpart and no app-level meaning on BifrOSt.

gaps: No SDK API for enumerating devices by class or matching criteria (IOServiceGetMatchingServices equivalent).
No device add or remove notification for apps; the shell polls /dev/input and sysfs.
No general registry property API for apps (IORegistryEntryGetProperty equivalent).
No app-facing driver-call or shared-memory interface (IOConnectCallMethod, IODataQueue equivalent).
Serial-port enumeration and modem open (IOSerialPort sample) do not exist.
Battery state is not exposed to apps (IOPowerSources equivalent); only the shell reads it.
Thermal state has no change notification (IOKit thermal notifications equivalent).
